## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Scope
- [ ] Single focused task
- [ ] No unrelated refactor

## Requirements and evidence

List acceptance criteria and the files/behavior that satisfy them.

## Security, data and cost impact

Describe authorization, RLS, migration, secrets, provider and cost implications.

## Tests

List exact commands run and results. Do not list checks that were not executed.

## Screenshots / recordings

Attach UI evidence where relevant.

## Risks and follow-ups

List known limitations, rollback needs and next actions.
